title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Overview

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page international.nubank.com.br/careers/.

Business Analysts at Nubank
As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience. It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency. We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious. You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks – even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

What are we looking for?

  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
  • Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

Sobre a Organização

Somos a Diffucap-Chemobras Química Farmacêutica Ltda., uma empresa consolidada no mercado farmacêutico e localizada no Rio de Janeiro. Somos certificados pela ANVISA com Boas Práticas de Fabricação, o que nos permite produzir medicamentos sólidos orais, incluindo os sujeitos ao controle especial da Portaria 344/98, em diversas classes terapêuticas.

Destacamo-nos não apenas pela terceirização de medicamentos para empresas globais, mas também pelo desenvolvimento e produção de nossos próprios medicamentos destinados à classe médica. Nossa equipe de vendas atua em todo o Brasil, realizando visitações médicas e odontológicas.

Um dos nossos principais diferenciais é o Sistema de Liberação Programada (SLP), que possibilita a criação de medicamentos de ação prolongada e altamente eficazes. Essa tecnologia inovadora permite ajustar a posologia e as concentrações desejadas, garantindo maior aderência ao tratamento e minimizando efeitos colaterais.

As formulações que utilizam a tecnologia SLP possuem registro sanitário junto à Anvisa para comercialização no Brasil. Além disso, buscamos parcerias com outras empresas para ampliar nosso portfólio, seja através de desenvolvimentos isolados e/ou em conjunto, terceirização de etapas de fabricação e/ou parcerias de comercialização.

Nossa empresa valoriza a inovação, qualidade e eficácia, sempre buscando evoluir no segmento farmacêutico e desenvolver produtos inovadores para nossa linha própria e para terceiros. Priorizamos o crescimento interno, o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional de nossos colaboradores, criando um ambiente de trabalho excelente.

Acreditamos que nossa relação sólida com o mercado de medicamentos no Brasil é construída com base no respeito, ética e compromisso com a saúde e bem-estar dos pacientes.

Por que trabalhar com a gente?

Apoiados por valores de respeito e solidariedade, nossa força e confiabilidade, e um compromisso com a excelência, implementamos firmemente nossa ambição em um ambiente desafiador e estimulante, onde a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo são valorizados.

Como uma empresa abrangente em todo território brasileiro que produz e comercializa medicamentos de uso humano, contamos não apenas com nossos valores e pontos fortes, mas também com nossa equipe para tornar nossa estratégia no ramo farmacêutico um sucesso e ser um ator importante na qualidade de vida.

Estamos buscando uma transição justa para nossos funcionários, stakeholders e a sociedade. Descubra o DNA de uma empresa responsável e comprometida.

Descubra um lugar onde você pode fazer a diferença, crescer profissionalmente e ainda ter benefícios que valorizam seu bem-estar.

Seja parte de uma história de sucesso, onde suas habilidades e experiências são valorizadas e contribuem para o nosso futuro.

Responsibilities

  1. Coletar, integrar e preparar dados provenientes de diferentes fontes (ERP, controles manuais, planilhas), garantindo qualidade, precisão e consistência.

  6. Melhorar continuamente os processos de gestão de dados, incluindo a implementação de controles para prevenir erros de entrada e elevar a qualidade da informação.
  7. Pesquisar e integrar novas fontes de dados, complementando e aprimorando bases já existentes.
  8. Traduzir análises complexas em informações claras, comunicando resultados para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  9. Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais (operações, manufatura, manutenção, qualidade, logística, finanças e TI) para compreender necessidades e desenvolver soluções analíticas relevantes.
  10. Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua, utilizando dados como base para decisões e proposição de melhorias.
  11. Contribuir para otimização de sistemas e fluxos de dados em parceria com áreas responsáveis e TI.
  12. Aplicar os Valores SEL, Princípios de Operações e Princípios de Manufatura de Classe Mundial.
  13. Entender. Criar. Simplificar.
  14. Executar outras atividades conforme necessário.

  • Experiência prévia em análise de dados ou business intelligence.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, incluindo Power Query.
  • Forte domínio de Power BI.
  • Proficiência em SQL.
  • Capacidade de aprender rapidamente e comunicar conceitos técnicos com clareza.
  • Habilidades analíticas, organização e gestão de projetos bem desenvolvidas.
  • Fluência em inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Capacidade de atuar tanto de forma independente quanto em colaboração com múltiplas equipes.

  • Familiaridade com processos ETL e Power Automate.
  • Vivência em aplicação de métodos estatísticos em ambientes de manufatura, design eletrônico ou de negócios.
  • Fluência em espanhol (leitura, escrita e conversação).

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: QA Officer New
description:
Job Description

Neem deel aan onze missie – ‘Feeding the Future’

Kickstart jouw carrière als QA Officer bij Nutreco – Tilburg

Ben jij klaar voor een impactvolle rol waarin je elke dag het verschil kunt maken? Bij Nutreco – een wereldspeler in innovatieve en duurzame diervoederoplossingen – zoeken we een gedreven QA Officer die ons kwaliteitsteam komt versterken.

Over de rol | verantwoordelijkheden:

In deze veelzijdige functie werk je aan het continu verbeteren en borgen van de kwaliteit van onze producten en processen. Je stelt kwaliteitsdocumenten op, ondersteunt audits, werkt aan CAPA’s en SCAR’s, onderzoekt klachten en zorgt voor de vrijgave van grondstoffen en eindproducten volgens wetgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van diverse afdelingen en vervangt de QA Manager bij afwezigheid.

Waarom je graag bij ons zou willen werken:

  • Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid én de ruimte om te leren en te groeien.
  • Je werkt in een informele, internationale omgeving met enthousiaste collega’s.
  • Je draagt bij aan onze missie feeding the future .
  • Je kunt rekenen op een marktconform salaris, 30 vakantiedagen, reiskostenvergoeding en volop ontwikkelkansen.
  • Je kunt bij ons hybride werken.

Vaardigheden en expertise | kwalificaties:

  • Een hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur richting Chemie of Voedingsmiddelentechnologie.
  • Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring binnen een kwaliteitsafdeling.
  • Kennis van kwaliteitssystemen, audits en relevante wetgeving.
  • Sterke communicatieve skills in Nederlands en Engels, nauwkeurigheid en eigenaarschap.

Volgende stappen:

We zorgen voor een soepel en duidelijk sollicitatieproces voor iedereen en willen graag binnen vijf (5) werkdagen reageren. Het wervingsproces neemt gewoonlijk 4-6 weken in beslag. We waarderen je interesse om deel te nemen aan onze missie om de toekomst van voedselproductie te innoveren en duurzaam vorm te geven.

Aanvullende informatie:

Nutreco maakt deel uit van de SHV-familie en wij zetten ons in voor 'Feeding the Future' door middel van duurzame en innovatieve praktijken. Nutreco heeft twee business lines: Skretting is een toonaangevende wereldwijde leverancier van innovatieve aquafeed-oplossingen, die een revolutie teweegbrengen in de aquacultuur voor een duurzame toekomst. Trouw Nutrition is gespecialiseerd in diervoeding en zet zich in om de gezondheid en productiviteit van vee te verbeteren door middel van geavanceerde oplossingen.

Selko is het merk voor diervoederadditieven van Trouw Nutrition en onderdeel van de Global Supply Points (GSP) organisatie met locaties in Nederland, Duitsland en de VS. GSP ondersteunt de wereldwijde levering van ingrediënten.

Onze fabriek in Tilburg is geclassificeerd als een Seveso -bedrijf. Dit betekent dat we werken met stoffen die gevaarlijk kunnen zijn voor mens en/of milieu en dat we ons houden aan strenge veiligheidseisen om risico's te minimaliseren. Binnen ons bedrijf staan het welzijn van onze medewerkers, de gezondheid van het milieu en de veiligheid van onze omgeving centraal. We vinden het belangrijk om vanaf het eerste contactmoment open en transparant te zijn over de risico's van onze activiteiten en de veiligheidseisen die we hanteren. We investeren in het verbeteren van onze processen en het opleiden van onze medewerkers om ervoor te zorgen dat we onze activiteiten op een veilige en verantwoorde manier kunnen uitvoeren.

Sabe como a gente faz tudo isso acontecer?

Ao redor do mundo, contamos com mais de 9 mil colaboradores – dos quais 4.700 são brasileiros. Todos eles atuam no gerenciamento de soluções personalizadas e cada vez mais inteligentes, que viabilizam uma jornada tranquila e integrada para o cliente.

Nosso objetivo é criar um ambiente de trabalho onde todos se sintam realizados, motivados e engajados.

Mais propósito, menos impacto, mais Indigo.

Porém, esse desenvolvimento precisa estar de acordo com o desejo das pessoas: menos estresse, ruídos, poluição e trânsito.

Por isso, “criar espaços para uma cidade tranquila em movimento” é o que fazemos na Indigo. Esse é o nosso propósito. É para isso que trabalhamos diariamente.

Trabalha junto a produto, engenharia e negócio para garantir alinhamento e clareza nas entregas. Contribui no atendimento a clientes internos e externos, traduzindo demandas em soluções eficientes. Atua como referência técnica, orientando o uso correto das plataformas e garantindo qualidade nas entregas.

Arquitetura & Pipelines: Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas modernas (Lakehouse, Mesh) e pipelines ETL/ELT robustos; Ingestão e Transformação: Implementar processos de coleta (APIs, Streams, SQL/NoSQL) e transformações complexas para garantir dados limpos e confiáveis; Habilitação de Analytics: Preparar camadas semânticas e datasets otimizados para consumo em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker, Tableau); Qualidade e Governança: Definir padrões técnicos, monitoramento contínuo, versionamento e automação de testes de integridade; Otimização de Performance: Identificar gargalos, otimizar consultas complexas e gerenciar custos em ambientes de grande volume.

Diferenciais: Data Mesh e Data Fabric; Design de Pipelines: Capacidade de desenhar fluxos ETL/ELT resilientes, com tratamento de erros, retentativas e idempotência; Orquestração de Fluxos: Domínio de ferramentas como Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou similares para gestão de dependências; Transformação de Dados: Conhecimento sólido em dbt (data build tool) para camadas de transformação e documentação; Provedores de Nuvem: Experiência sólida em pelo menos um grande player (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e seus serviços específicos de dados (ex: Glue, Redshift, BigQuery, Synapse, Data Factory); Observabilidade: Implementação de logs, monitoramento de saúde de pipelines e alertas.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.
Team & Culture
  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.
You can be a Rock-Star if you have Core Skills & Experience
  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.
Key Qualities
  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.
Bonus Points
  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.
Living Our Values
  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.
Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check and psychometric profiling
  • Offer
How To Apply
  • Submit your CV in English, as this is the main language used at InPlanet (Portuguese accepted if justified).

Being an equal opportunity employer, InPlanet does not discriminate on grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We design our processes to be fair and equitable and believe in continuous learning.

description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

What You Will Do
  • Partner with the managers, directors and technical leaders of our organization to elevate our architecture practices to the next level;
  • Collaborate and support the technical leaders in making technical decisions following our standards and guardrails/guidelines;
  • Help other teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical debts and bugs;
  • Foster adoption of best coding practices and patterns;
  • Write technical documentation (with charts, data points and diagrams) and present technical solutions to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner;
  • Help create the architecture principles and present to different stakeholders (e.g.: managers, technical leaders, directors, product managers);
  • Suggest, develop and implement new tools and technologies to solve cross-functional problems;

  • Identify possible improvements in our overall architecture, perform proof of concepts (POCs) and drive the adoption of new architectural concepts with different teams;
  • Assist in the career development of other developers by providing technical mentoring, pair programming and/or reviewing PRs;
  • Actively contribute to our Backend community by planning, executing and presenting in our Backend Guild sharing technical knowledge;

What You Will Need
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field OR relevant time Software Engineering work experience;

  • Experience in Systems Architectural styles (Monolith, Plugin, SOA, Microservices, Event-driven);

  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms and main providers;

  • Experience in System Modeling (desirable experience in tactical DDD);
  • Familiarity with Monitoring Tools, Metrics, and Observability;

  • Knowledge of Quality practices (stress tests, load, TDD, BDD);

Sobre a Odontoclinic

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso só é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado.

Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, colecionamos conquistas como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e o reconhecimento como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui — reflexo da nossa paixão por servir e do nosso compromisso com a qualidade em cada detalhe.

Aqui, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento de pessoas é o caminho para construir resultados sustentáveis. Por isso, investimos constantemente em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional dos nossos colaboradores. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento.

Na Odontoclinic, você encontra um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e cheio de oportunidades. Um lugar onde você pode ser quem é, crescer, aprender e deixar sua marca. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.
